checkpoint: minimum VAL material L1 plus 0.1 edge L1; no TEST access
selection_statistical_unit: equal-weight parent average over its clean and noisy observations
post_correction_material_metric: mean amplitude NRMSE of online top1; if no physically feasible top1, use the common GN material error as an explicit selection-only failure fill, retaining FAIL in all deployment success counts
post_correction_physical_rate: number of observations with physically qualified online top1 divided by all156 planned observations
incomplete_run: not eligible for selection; missing cases are not dropped

alpha.alpha1: reuse existing J-full prediction/evaluation exactly; no duplicate physical computation
alpha.eligibility: physical rate no more than0.05 below alpha1
alpha.selection: minimum failure-filled mean material NRMSE; tie within1e-12 favors larger alpha
alpha.endpoint0: reuse separately trained g_dark, report that posthoc selection is not the trained stage trajectory
alpha.endpoint1: reuse j_full; no artificial sixth distinct model
alpha.interior: train soft_dark from scratch using the selected global alpha

constrained_arm.selection: minimum failure-filled mean material NRMSE; ties favor physical rate then lexicographic run name
constrained_arm.use: extra seeds17/27 and const/internal loss arms; TEST cannot change this choice

optional_full_vie_finetune.reference: same spatial arm, seed7, material-only loss
optional_full_vie_finetune.selection: best qualifying const/internal arm by failure-filled mean NRMSE; preserve all loss results

new_recurrent_feedback: supplementary user-requested architecture; no new model may be selected using TEST; training status and any VAL-only inclusion must be frozen explicitly
